name: Neumann images and plate relations
description: The shared archetypal whole in sequence: the round, its metabolism, the world-parent separation with the paśu correction, the twins' signed alternative, the hero's two emancipations and Osiris transformation, centroversion, the performable paper scene, the self-rolling wheel, and the return bond.

scenes.name: The world has parents before the person who distinguishes them
scenes.character: The round holds their possibility together: womb, egg, enclosing waters, the serpent with its tail in its mouth.

entities.name: the round — enclosing outline carrying the life that will differ
womb, egg, waters, uroboros — the held possibilities
the future ego — dependent before it can represent the dependence

text.title: The round holds their possibility together
text.italic: Womb, egg, waters, serpent: one enclosure.

scenes.name: The round lives by taking into itself
scenes.character: Mouth meets tail; hunger prevents an inert totality; the Great Mother's two faces; nourishment against Saturnine monopoly; centroversion audible already.

entities.name: mouth and tail — eater and eaten in one body
the Great Mother — the giving face beside the taking face
Prajāpati's self-offering — creation as offering to himself

text.title: The round lives by taking into itself
text.italic: Mouth meets tail; hunger keeps it from inertness.

scenes.name: Separation of the World Parents — and the paśu correction
scenes.character: Heaven distinguishable from earth; the androgyne recognises itself, then divides; Taylor's correction: I-am recognition precedes separation into husband and wife.

entities.name: sky lifting from earth — the interval in which a world can appear
the primordial person — recognises itself, then divides
the paśu correction — the light already burning before the I-am claims it

text.title: Separation opens the interval in which a world can appear
text.italic: Heaven distinguishable from earth; light enters the space between.

scenes.name: The twins — and the signed alternative
scenes.character: Ohrmazd and Ahriman: the broken halves of a prior 0 become enemies when division denies their belonging. (-1)/(+1) retains polarity; addition cancels; subtraction appropriates.

entities.name: the prior 0 — their shared genesis
Ohrmazd — the light half
Ahriman — the dark half
the light half held beside its contrary
the dark half held beside its contrary

text.title: Two faces within one genesis
text.italic: Each keeps its sign, or the relation cancels and takes.

scenes.name: The hero's two emancipations; the captive and treasure; Osiris
scenes.character: Slaying of the mother, then of the father — keeping both in sequence makes emancipation answerable to the actual formation of a centre, not the replacement of one captor by another.

entities.name: the hero born within the opened world
the maternal struggle — the engulfing origin addressed
the paternal struggle — the arresting law addressed
the captive, the treasure, liberation — tested by what release makes possible
the Osiris transformation — death preventing closure as victorious identity

text.title: The hero's two emancipations
text.italic: Escape must not merely change captors.

scenes.name: The paper scene — the return made performable
scenes.character: Write 1. Attend to the paper and write 0. Inscribe the slash. The written 0/1 is itself a figure; erase it — the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing is not cancelled.

entities.name: the blank sheet
the act performed — write, attend, inscribe, erase
the capacity that remains — not the literal substance of awareness

text.title: The return made performable
text.italic: What disappears is the inscription; the capacity remains.

scenes.name: The self-rolling wheel — continuing self-composition
scenes.character: En-Soph, plenitude and nothingness beside the wheel: the formed round must keep being made; its movement is the winding of a relation, not a finished circle bestowed once.

entities.name: the self-rolling wheel — continuing self-composition about the opening
En-Soph — plenitude and nothingness beside the wheel
the opening retained — neither perpetual motion nor a topology theorem

text.title: The self-rolling wheel
text.italic: The formed round must keep being made.

scenes.name: The return bond — knowing-as-cutting answerable to knowing-with
scenes.character: Even denial takes place through the field it denies. The eightfold recapitulation complete; the coequal Name and Power series; the sign becomes Symbol again.

entities.name: the shared genesis — indelible bond of the marriage image
the cut and the bond — two logics of two
the coequal series — Name beside Power, six by six

text.title: The return bond
text.italic: Even denial takes place through the field it denies.
